variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by {company}.
variants.body:
The company {company} has laid off many workers. The scale is described as large, but a specific number is not supplied here. In assessing {target}, readers should distinguish the loss of jobs from an invented cause, severance arrangement or account of what will happen to those affected.

Our politics should have something serious to say about people losing work. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.sub: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff.
variants.body:
Many workers have been laid off by {company}. The event puts employment at the centre of the colony's business news. For {target}, the relevant scrutiny concerns responsibility towards people and the handling of work, without assuming either the company's trade or its financial reasons for the decision.

Our politics should have something serious to say about people losing work. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.sub: The company {company} has laid off many workers.
variants.body:
The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. The loss of work deserves attention without an embellished account of individual households. Readers judging {target} should be able to consider the seriousness of the event without accepting unreported promises of new employment or support.

Our politics should have something serious to say about people losing work. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
